BlobContainerNote: Cloning works by copying all files to a new container. This may take a while if there are lots of blobs.
CloneItemNote: Cloning works by copying to a new location. Cloning a large item or a folder with lots of items may take a while. Snapshot data will not be preserved.
FileShareNote: Cloning works by copying all files to a new share. This may take a while if there are lots of files.
ItemNote: Renaming works by copying to a new location, then deleting the source item. Renaming a large item or a folder with lots of items may take a while. Snapshot data will not be preserved.
TableNote: Renaming works by copying to a new table, then deleting the source table. This may take a while if there are lots of entities. Properties and metadata will not be preserved.
